t: Blow torch with heavy duty, metal construction. Features precision flame adjuster, trigger on/off with trigger lock, and Twist ‘N’ Lock mechanism for quick burner changes. Includes Cyclone burner and Cool Tip burner. To maintain minimum tip temperature, the Cool Tip burner should be operated at full adjustment. Compatible with other Rothenberger burner tips (sold separately). Suitable for professional and DIY use.
b: Supplied With 1 x Standard Cyclone & 1 x Cool Tip Burners
